compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen displays a list of detox drink recipes categorized under "Categories." The main contents include:

1. A navigation bar at the top with a menu icon, the title "Categories," and a search icon.
2. A list of detox drink recipes, each with a thumbnail image, title, and category label. Examples include:
   - "#Detox Green Smoothie Recipe" under "Smoothies"
   - "5 Ingredient Detox Smoothie" under "Smoothies"
   - "A Liver Detox Tea" under "Juice & Tea"
   - "Anti-Inflammatory Tea" under "Juice & Tea"
   - "Apple Cider Vinegar and Lemon Detox Drink" under "Juice & Tea"
   - "Apple Cinnamon Detox Blast" under "Detox Water"
   - "Apple Cinnamon Detox Water" under "Detox Water"
3. An advertisement for the "Wish - Shopping Made Fun" app, placed between the recipe listings.
